reason: Rests on the same studies (Joseph 2021, Melamed 2019) as muscle-exertion-oxygen-extraction, which is graded several; Mackay 2026 adds ME/CFS iCPET and LC iCPET (Kahn 2024, Leitner 2024, Singh 2023) replicates the pattern.
Independent replication: Aschman 2023 (Charite) and Tryfonos 2025 (Karolinska) both find capillary/basement-membrane changes.
Azcue 2024 (67 vs 43) found serum NfL higher in ME/CFS, conflicting with the null framing.
Hsu 2024 Taiwan registry: bacterial pneumonia also raises ME/CFS risk (aHR about 1.4), weakening viral specificity.
Thapaliya 2023 7T finds larger, not smaller, brainstem volumes; reword the finding to direction-neutral 'altered'.
No change; Naik 2026 RCT (160, null) adds a second RCT, about 300 randomised in total.
